court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Rupesh Babnrao Kapse vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Ps Hudkeshwar ... on 23 January, 2023

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Mr. Rupesh Babanrao Kapse (husband), Sameer S/o Motiram Pakhare, Ramchandra S/o Sampatrao Dandekar, Smt. Roshni W/o Rupesh Kapse, Dhiraj S/o Sunil Uikey, Suraj S/o Bharat Kawade
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra Through P. S. O. Police Station Hudkeshwar, Nagpur, Mrs. Roshni Rupesh Kapse (wife), Rupesh S/o Babanrao Kapse

facts_of_case: Dispute between husband and wife; FIRs filed by both parties against each other.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle disputes amicably and withdraw criminal cases.
legal_principles.held: They decided to severe the matrimonial ties and jointly applied for mutual divorce in terms of Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can withdraw criminal cases if they settle the dispute amicably.
legal_principles.held: As per the agreed terms, the parties do not wish to prosecute the respective criminal cases.

outcome.final_order: Matter is taken up for final hearing with the consent of both sides.
